documents.title: ClaimGate Framework
documents.summary: ClaimGate is an offline, deterministic, source-grounded claim review framework for public-data AI outputs. It helps teams pull risky AI-produced claims into a human review workflow where every accepted claim must trace back to a source anchor and auditable evidence.

documents.title: Security Policy
documents.summary: ClaimGate v0 is an offline, deterministic, fixture-first framework evaluation surface. It intentionally excludes production network and identity infrastructure so reviewers can inspect the trust boundary without secret handling.

decisions.decision: ClaimGate keeps kbctl as a project-local JSON knowledge CLI under tools/kbctl rather than introducing a server, database, or external knowledge service.
decisions.rationale: OSSContest preparation needs queryable local context while preserving the v0 offline deterministic boundary.

decisions.decision: FisherMan domain records are not copied into ClaimGate; only the reusable kbctl implementation and operation pattern are migrated.
decisions.rationale: Cross-project domain records would contaminate ClaimGate submission context. ClaimGate gets a new claimgate-kb.json seeded from its own docs.

decisions.decision: ClaimGate documentation is indexed as kbctl document records so report, demo, verification, and package-boundary docs can be searched before submission work.
decisions.rationale: Document indexing gives fast local context recovery without claiming Obsidian/vault or private runtime state is part of the public product.

decisions.decision: ClaimGate의 본질은 AI 판단기가 아니라 AI 후보 주장을 출처 앵커, 결정론적 위험 규칙, 사람 검토, Evidence Pack으로 통과시키는 Claim Gate로 설명한다.
decisions.rationale: 출품 문구가 구현 범위를 넘지 않게 하고 AI Curator, Not Judge 원칙을 공개 설명의 중심에 두기 위해서다.

decisions.decision: OSSContest 목표는 production SaaS가 아니라 오프라인 deterministic public-data claim review framework와 재현 가능한 evaluator smoke를 제출하는 것이다.
decisions.rationale: v0는 서버, DB, auth, 실시간 LLM/OCR/API 호출을 의도적으로 제외하므로 심사자는 pnpm eval:framework와 문서로 구현 경계를 확인해야 한다.

decisions.decision: 현재 구현 상태는 pure TypeScript core, controlled React UI, conformance kit, civic/health/mofa-oda DomainPack, fixture demo, verification scripts, kbctl knowledge index가 작동하는 v0 framework로 기술한다.
decisions.rationale: 구현된 표면과 미구현 표면을 분리해야 개발보고서와 3분 영상에서 과장 없는 설명을 유지할 수 있다.

decisions.decision: proposedAnchor는 자동으로 Source Anchor가 되지 않는다. Source anchoring workflow가 명시적으로 accept한 경우에만 AttachSourceAnchor command가 실제 Source Anchor를 붙인다.
decisions.rationale: AI Curator Not Judge와 No Anchor No Claim을 동시에 지키려면 AI 제안과 권한 있는 출처 부착을 분리해야 한다.

decisions.decision: Local Gemma/RAG provenance는 EvidencePack metadata와 Claim creation audit actor/reason에 보존하되, authority가 아니라 provenance로만 해석한다.
decisions.rationale: 출품 영상에서 local model tag, adapter id, prompt/tuning-card version, RAG corpus ids를 보여줘야 하지만 AI가 검증 주체로 오해되면 안 된다.

decisions.decision: EvidencePack은 생성 시점의 immutable snapshot이다. Claim이 이후 바뀌면 기존 pack을 수정하지 않고 새 pack을 발행하거나 supersede 관계를 남긴다.
decisions.rationale: Evidence Pack First 원칙의 핵심은 재현 가능한 감사 산출물이므로 과거 pack mutation을 허용하면 감사성이 깨진다.

decisions.decision: v0 Claim은 single primary Source Anchor를 유지하고 복합 주장은 atomic subclaims로 분해한다. multi-anchor Claim aggregate는 별도 scenario에서 다룬다.
decisions.rationale: 현재 SourceAnchor/Claim model과 데모 안정성을 보존하면서 복합 주장을 허위 단일 앵커로 검증하는 문제를 피한다.

decisions.decision: RAG no-hit은 extraction failure 또는 needs-evidence candidate로 분리하고, RAG conflict는 extracted candidate를 유지한 뒤 deterministic risk에서 conflict로 보낸다.
decisions.rationale: 추출 단계가 진실 판정을 하지 않도록 하면서 출처 부족과 출처 충돌을 다른 도메인 사건으로 관찰할 수 있다.

decisions.decision: green sampling에서 core는 sampling mechanism만 제공하고 sampling policy default는 DomainPack 또는 host application이 정한다.
decisions.rationale: 도메인마다 false-negative risk tolerance가 다르므로 core에 단일 정책을 박으면 도메인 판단이 core로 새어 들어온다.

decisions.decision: v0 in-memory slice에서는 단일 reviewer terminal decision만 허용한다. repository/server가 도입되면 optimistic concurrency와 append-only decision event ordering을 추가한다.

decisions.decision: Local Gemma/RAG demo treats RAG no-hit as fail-loud extraction failure rather than returning zero-score documents as grounding evidence.
decisions.rationale: R-14 requires no-hit not to be silently treated as verified or grounded evidence. The demo now filters lexical retrieval to positive hits and throws when no hit remains.

decisions.decision: EvidencePack supersede relation is represented by creating a new immutable generated pack that records supersedes and supersedeReason; the previous pack remains byte-stable.
decisions.rationale: R-13 and AGG-2 require later claim/evidence changes to create a new pack or relation without mutating the original EvidencePack snapshot.

decisions.decision: EvidencePack metadata may preserve local model, adapter, prompt, and RAG provenance only; review, risk, verification, and projection authority-shaped metadata is rejected.
decisions.rationale: R-12 requires Gemma/RAG information to remain provenance rather than verification authority. The demo keeps aiAuthority=candidate-only, and core now rejects metadata keys or aiAuthority values that would imply AI review or projection power.

decisions.decision: Report and Graph projectors must re-check EvidencePack runtime invariants instead of trusting a structurally forged EvidencePack interface.
decisions.rationale: R-4 is protected by createEvidencePack and projection-guards, but JavaScript callers can still pass forged objects to projectors. Projector entrypoints now reject non verified/corrected, missing-source, anchor-mismatch, missing-reviewer, missing-audit, or malformed corrected EvidenceItem records before rendering report or graph outputs.

decisions.decision: Terminal reviewer decisions require a non-blank reviewer identity, and projection guards reject forged reviewer audit events with blank reviewer ids.
decisions.rationale: R-3 requires a reviewer-audited terminal decision, not merely a truthy reviewer object or structurally forged reviewer actor. Blank reviewer ids could otherwise produce terminal audit events or projectable forged claims without accountable reviewer identity.

decisions.decision: v0 projection eligibility requires exactly one matching reviewer terminal decision audit; duplicate forged terminal decision events are not projectable.
decisions.rationale: The normal in-memory state machine already has no outgoing transitions from verified/corrected/rejected states. Projection guards must enforce the same single-terminal-decision invariant for structurally forged Claim objects because JavaScript callers can construct objects outside transitionClaim.

decisions.decision: No Anchor, No Claim treats malformed SourceAnchor objects as no anchor; sourceId and variant coordinates must be valid before attachment, terminal verification, Claim projection, or EvidencePack projector output.
decisions.rationale: R-2 requires a real Source Anchor, not merely an object in the anchor field. Blank source identities could otherwise pass transition/projector guards as if they were anchored evidence.

decisions.decision: Extractor outputs are normalized and frozen at the CandidateClaim boundary; proposedAnchor remains immutable proposal data and createExtractedClaimFromCandidate never attaches it to Claim.anchor.
decisions.rationale: R-9 requires proposedAnchor to remain separate from accepted Source Anchor. Future adapters could otherwise return mutable proposedAnchor objects whose coordinates change before a source anchoring workflow reviews them.

decisions.decision: v0 rejects multi-anchor-shaped Claim and CandidateClaim inputs; composite claims must be decomposed into atomic subclaims rather than silently choosing or ignoring anchors.
decisions.rationale: R-11 allows one primary Source Anchor only. Extra anchor collections such as anchors/sourceAnchors/evidenceAnchors/proposedAnchors could otherwise hide composite claims or let forged Claims project with multiple anchors.

decisions.decision: CandidateClaim normalization is allowlist-based and proposed Source Anchor objects are strict-shape validated; hidden metadata or nested authority fields are rejected instead of silently dropped.
decisions.rationale: R-1 requires AI/LLM extractors to propose candidates only. Silently discarding unknown candidate fields or preserving unsupported proposedAnchor fields could hide reviewer, risk, verification, or projection authority in adapter output.

decisions.decision: DomainPack conformance treats risk decisions as closed-shape deterministic outputs: AI risk authority fields are forbidden, trace entries must use allowed levels, and at least one trace entry must explain the produced risk level.
decisions.rationale: R-5 applies to pack-owned risk rules as well as core risk evaluation. A pack returning aiRiskScore or a red decision with only green traces would preserve an apparent deterministic result while hiding AI scoring authority or an unexplained rule trace.

decisions.decision: Core green sampling has no implicit sampling-rate/minimum policy; green claims are sampled only when DomainPack or host application supplies explicit greenSampleRate or minGreenSampleCount.
decisions.rationale: R-15/D-012 separate mechanism ownership from policy ownership. A core default of 10% plus minimum one review was a hidden policy choice and could overstate domain false-negative tolerance.

decisions.decision: Local Gemma demo execution is fail-closed to local Ollama HTTP endpoints and non-URL local model tags, and demo output explicitly discloses lexical fixture RAG plus absence of repo fine-tuning artifacts.
decisions.rationale: R-6/R-7/R-8 require honest contest/demo boundaries. Without local endpoint validation the Ollama path could call hosted APIs; without output disclosure the demo could overclaim production vector RAG or fine-tuned Gemma artifacts that are not implemented.

decisions.decision: Local Gemma/RAG demo Evidence Pack metadata must carry demo RAG mode and tuning artifact status as provenance while preserving aiAuthority=candidate-only.
decisions.rationale: R-7/R-8/R-12 require contest demos to disclose lexical fixture retrieval and absence of fine-tuned Gemma artifacts in the generated artifact, not only terminal prose.

decisions.decision: The MOFA Local Gemma demo fails closed when extracted candidates do not match the MOFA safety scenario; it must not attach the MOFA safety fixture Source Anchor to an unrelated AI candidate.
decisions.rationale: R-14 requires RAG conflicts to remain candidate input resolved by deterministic risk/reviewer workflow. Falling back to candidates[0] could force a fixture conflict onto unrelated model output.

decisions.decision: DomainPack conformance now requires every declared riskRule to be exercised by at least one fixture.
decisions.rationale: R-5 deterministic rule trace is weaker if a pack can declare untested rules. Contest extensibility should claim exercised offline pack rules, not dormant community ecosystem coverage.

decisions.decision: Contest-facing docs must distinguish current offline fixtures and RTX 4090 local Ollama/Gemma candidate extraction from future live OpenAPI adapters, production vector RAG, and fine-tuned model artifacts.
decisions.rationale: Submission materials are evidence surfaces and must not overclaim current implementation. kbctl remains the SSOT; docs are bounded views that must not present AI mock as the product demo.

decisions.decision: Submission video target is the real RTX 4090 local Ollama/Gemma candidate-extraction path; public demo scripts and docs must not present an AI test double path as the product demo.
decisions.rationale: The project is still in design/review hardening, but the intended contest demonstration will use the available RTX 4090 node. Test doubles may remain inside automated tests only and must not be described as the product AI path.

decisions.decision: RTX 4090 local Ollama/Gemma smoke uses model tag gemma4:12b on the default local endpoint and is the accepted submission-video AI path.
decisions.rationale: pnpm demo:ai:gemma passed on 2026-08-17 and produced candidate-only Evidence Pack output with provider=ollama, model=gemma4:12b, aiAuthority=candidate-only, lexical fixture RAG disclosure, and no fine-tuned artifact claim.

decisions.decision: Local Gemma/RAG adapter and demo-grade lexical retrieval now live in @claimgate/ai-local outside @claimgate/core; scripts/ai-claim-demo.ts is only the MOFA ODA application composition slice.
decisions.rationale: DDD refactoring requires the model runtime and RAG boundary to be explicit without contaminating core trust invariants. The adapter package can guard local Ollama endpoints, model tags, prompt/RAG provenance, and CandidateClaim-only output while core remains framework/model independent.

decisions.decision: Source Anchor acceptance is now a first-class core workflow: reviewer/source authority must call acceptSourceAnchor or acceptProposedSourceAnchor before an anchor becomes the Claim primary SourceAnchor; rejectProposedSourceAnchor records rejected proposals without attaching them.
decisions.rationale: R-9/INV-6 needed executable behavior, not script-local convention. This preserves AI Curator, Not Judge while allowing the Local Gemma/RAG demo to show a reviewed Source Anchor acceptance step.

decisions.decision: Evidence Pack lifecycle is now explicit: generated packs remain immutable; supersedeEvidencePack and reissueEvidencePack create new generated-with-supersedes snapshots; revokeEvidencePack creates a separate immutable revocation record without mutating the original pack.
decisions.rationale: KG-5/R-13 require audit-safe reproducibility. Later claim/source changes must not rewrite prior Evidence Pack JSON; lifecycle changes are represented by new snapshots or separate revocation records.

decisions.decision: Atomic Claim decomposition is now explicit: composite multi-fact drafts must be decomposed with decomposeCompositeClaimDraft into extracted atomic CandidateClaim[] entries before Claim review; each atom may carry at most one proposedAnchor and no review/risk/projection authority.
decisions.rationale: KG-7/R-11/INV-7 require preserving the v0 single-primary-Source-Anchor Claim model without pretending one anchor proves a composite public-data statement. Decomposition happens before source-anchor acceptance and reviewer decisions.

decisions.decision: RAG grounding policy is now explicit in @claimgate/ai-local: assessRagGrounding classifies hit, no-hit, and conflict; no-hit either fails extraction or creates an extracted needs-evidence candidate without proposed anchors; RAG conflict remains extracted candidate input for deterministic risk/reviewer workflow.
decisions.rationale: KG-2/R-14/INV-10 require avoiding silent evidence fabrication while still preserving candidate input for conflicts. This keeps RAG as retrieval/provenance, not verification authority.

decisions.decision: Reviewer terminal decision concurrency is now explicit in core: claimReviewVersion exposes the append-only audit length and applyTerminalReviewerDecision rejects stale expected versions before applying verified/corrected/rejected decisions.
decisions.rationale: KG-3/R-10 needed executable policy beyond the implicit terminal-state transition table. The v0 in-memory slice still permits only one terminal reviewer decision, and future repository/server code can use expectedVersion as an optimistic concurrency check.

decisions.decision: Extraction provenance is now a reusable core contract: buildExtractionProvenanceMetadata writes candidate-only Evidence Pack metadata, and extractionProvenanceActorId/extractionProvenanceAuditReason preserve provider/model/adapter/prompt/RAG/tuning-card provenance in Claim creation audit without granting AI authority.
decisions.rationale: KG-4/R-12 required provenance to be visible in both audit and Evidence Pack output while preserving AI Curator, Not Judge. The demo now uses the same core helpers instead of hand-built metadata strings.

decisions.decision: Green sampling ownership is explicit: core owns the deterministic buildRiskQueue mechanism; DomainPack may publish greenSamplingPolicyRecommendation; host code must intentionally pass greenSamplingOptionsFromDomainPack or its own options.
decisions.rationale: KG-6/R-15 required avoiding a hidden global default while still allowing packs such as mofa-oda to recommend false-negative sampling policy.

decisions.decision: Future repository/server concurrency is represented by a pure ClaimRepository port and in-memory contract: snapshots carry claimReviewVersion, save(expectedVersion) rejects stale writes, and terminal reviewer decisions remain single-winner.
decisions.rationale: KG-3/R-10 can now be tested at the repository boundary without adding a server or database to v0. A future DB adapter must implement the same compare-and-set semantics with append-only event ordering.

decisions.decision: MOFA ODA RAG is now a repo-local persistent sparse-vector index: @claimgate/ai-local can build/search/round-trip RagIndex JSON, scripts/build-local-rag-index.ts writes artifacts/local-ai/mofa-oda-rag-index.json, and the Local Gemma demo uses this index instead of the previous lexical-only retrieval.
decisions.rationale: R-7 previously said RAG was demo-grade lexical only. The contest/local path now has a durable local retrieval artifact without introducing an external vector DB or granting RAG verification authority.

decisions.decision: Gemma tuning preparation is now implemented as a candidate-only dataset and training preflight: scripts/build-gemma-tuning-dataset.ts writes JSONL, scripts/gemma-tuning-preflight.ts verifies RTX 4090 plus dataset readiness, and scripts/train-gemma-candidate-lora.py is the optional LoRA training entrypoint. No trained LoRA/checkpoint artifact is claimed until that training command is run.
decisions.rationale: The user wants real local Gemma tuning, but ClaimGate must not overclaim a model artifact. The repo now contains the reproducible dataset/preflight/training entrypoint while preserving AI Curator, Not Judge.

decisions.decision: Gemma tuning preflight is now strict: it validates candidate-only JSONL, RTX 4090 identity, roughly 24GB VRAM, at least 18GB free VRAM, required Python training modules, and explicit Gemma 12B base-model selection before reporting trainingReady=ready.
decisions.rationale: The earlier preflight proved only prerequisites and could overstate readiness while Ollama processes occupied VRAM, transformers/peft were broken, or no base model was selected. The preflight must fail closed until the node can actually start a Gemma 12B LoRA run.

decisions.decision: Gemma 4 12B candidate-only one-step LoRA smoke training completed locally on RTX 4090; the adapter lives under ignored local artifacts and is only pipeline evidence, not a production-quality tuned checkpoint.
decisions.rationale: The contest/demo path needs evidence that the RTX 4090 tuning pipeline can actually run while preserving AI Curator, Not Judge. The artifact proves local training mechanics only; review, risk, source anchoring, and projection authority remain deterministic/reviewer-owned.

decisions.decision: Actual RTX 4090 local Ollama/Gemma demo command passed with model gemma4:12b on local port 29134, producing one candidate, MOFA sparse-vector RAG hits, deterministic red/conflict risk, reviewer correction, Evidence Pack JSON, Markdown report, and graph projection.
decisions.rationale: The contest video path now has real local Gemma runtime evidence instead of only test doubles. The output still preserves AI authority as candidate-only and discloses that the local LoRA smoke adapter is pipeline evidence, not production-quality tuning.

decisions.decision: Gemma 4 12B candidate-only LoRA prototype training completed locally on RTX 4090 with 20 max steps and passed artifact validation; the adapter remains local pipeline evidence only, not production-quality tuning and not connected to Ollama serving.
decisions.rationale: The tuning lane has moved beyond 1-step smoke to a bounded prototype, while preserving the ClaimGate authority boundary. Because the dataset has only 3 examples and no quality eval corpus, the result must not be presented as a production extractor.

decisions.rationale: This separates useful tuning progress from demo/product overclaim. The adapter demonstrates local PEFT inference and candidate-boundary behavior, but extra generated JSON/text means it cannot be wired into the Ollama/demo path without a stricter decoder, stop condition, or additional format tuning.

decisions.decision: Local Gemma/Ollama candidate parser now uses a safe first-JSON postprocessor: it extracts the first complete JSON object, validates candidates[] through core CandidateClaim authority guards, flags trailing text diagnostics, and ignores extra model chatter without granting reviewer/risk/projection authority.
decisions.rationale: The prototype LoRA adapter can generate valid candidate JSON followed by extra text. Treating the first JSON object as a candidate-only boundary artifact lets the demo path consume candidates safely while still reporting raw strict JSON serving as blocked and non-production-quality.

ddd_questions.question: Gemma가 제안한 proposedAnchor를 어떤 조건에서 실제 Source Anchor로 승격할 수 있는가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: proposedAnchor는 절대 자동 승격하지 않는다. Source anchoring workflow가 sourceId/kind/locator/excerpt를 검토해 accept하면 AttachSourceAnchor command가 실제 Source Anchor를 붙인다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: AI Curator Not Judge와 No Anchor No Claim을 동시에 지키려면 제안과 부착 권한을 분리해야 한다.
ddd_questions.options: A: reviewer/source workflow acceptance required; B: deterministic exact-match auto-accept for fixture only; C: never use proposedAnchor
ddd_questions.answer: D-007: proposedAnchor는 자동 승격되지 않고 source anchoring workflow가 accept할 때만 실제 Source Anchor가 된다.

ddd_questions.question: RAG 검색 결과가 없거나 서로 충돌할 때 후보 주장은 rejected가 되는가, needs-evidence가 되는가, 아니면 추출 단계에서 제외되는가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: RAG no-hit은 extraction failure 또는 needs-evidence candidate로 분리하고, RAG conflict는 extracted candidate 유지 후 deterministic risk에서 conflict로 보낸다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: 추출 단계에서 truth judgment를 하지 않으면서도 출처 부족과 출처 충돌을 다르게 관찰할 수 있다.
ddd_questions.options: A: no-hit rejects extraction; B: no-hit creates needs-evidence candidate; C: no-hit/conflict both enter review queue
ddd_questions.answer: D-011: RAG no-hit은 extraction failure 또는 needs-evidence candidate, RAG conflict는 extracted 유지 후 deterministic risk conflict.

ddd_questions.question: 동일 claim id 또는 동일 source anchor에 대해 두 검토자가 동시에 다른 terminal decision을 내리면 어떤 결정이 정본인가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: 현재 v0 in-memory slice에서는 단일 reviewer terminal decision만 허용한다고 문서화한다. repository/server가 생기면 optimistic concurrency와 append-only decision event ordering을 도입한다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: 현재 제품에는 서버/DB가 없으므로 정책을 과하게 구현하지 않되, future persistence가 생길 때 aggregate version이 필요함을 숨기지 않는다.
ddd_questions.options: A: single terminal decision invariant; B: latest reviewer wins; C: quorum/appeal workflow
ddd_questions.answer: D-013/D-041/D-044: v0는 단일 reviewer terminal decision만 허용한다. core는 claimReviewVersion + applyTerminalReviewerDecision(expectedVersion)로 optimistic concurrency hook을 제공하고, ClaimRepository.save(expectedVersion)로 future repository/server compare-and-set 경계를 모델링한다. 실제 persistence adapter는 append-only decision event ordering을 보존해야 한다.

ddd_questions.question: 튜닝된 Gemma 모델 산출물의 버전, 데이터셋, 프롬프트/어댑터 버전은 Claim audit 또는 Evidence Pack metadata 중 어디에 보존해야 하는가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: Gemma model tag, adapter id, prompt/tuning-card version, RAG corpus ids는 EvidencePack metadata와 Claim create audit reason/actor id에 보존한다. 단, 이 metadata는 authority가 아니라 provenance다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: 출품 영상에서는 local model provenance를 보여줘야 하지만 AI가 검증 주체로 오해되면 안 된다.
ddd_questions.options: A: EvidencePack metadata only; B: Claim audit only; C: both metadata and audit with authority disclaimer
ddd_questions.answer: D-008/D-042: model tag, adapter id, prompt/tuning-card version, RAG corpus ids, retrieval mode, tuning artifact status, and aiAuthority=candidate-only are preserved via core ExtractionProvenance helpers in EvidencePack metadata and Claim creation audit reason/actor id. They remain provenance, never verification authority.

ddd_questions.question: Evidence Pack 생성 후 Claim이 수정되면 기존 pack은 불변 snapshot으로 남는가, 아니면 pack 재발행/폐기 이벤트가 필요한가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: EvidencePack은 생성 시점의 immutable snapshot으로 취급한다. Claim이 이후 바뀌면 새 pack을 발행하고 이전 pack을 수정하지 않는다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: Evidence Pack First 원칙은 재현 가능한 감사 산출물이 핵심이므로 과거 pack mutation은 피해야 한다.
ddd_questions.options: A: immutable snapshot and supersede; B: mutable latest pack; C: regenerate without history
ddd_questions.answer: D-009: EvidencePack은 immutable snapshot이며 이후 변경은 새 pack 발행 또는 supersede 관계로 표현한다.

ddd_questions.question: green으로 분류된 후보의 샘플링 비율은 pack별 정책인가, 전체 ClaimGate 정책인가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: core는 sampling mechanism만 제공하고 sampling policy default는 DomainPack 또는 host application이 정한다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: 도메인마다 false-negative risk tolerance가 다르므로 core에 단일 비율을 박으면 도메인 정책이 core로 새어 들어온다.
ddd_questions.options: A: core-owned fixed default; B: DomainPack policy; C: host app policy with pack recommendation
ddd_questions.answer: D-012/D-043: core owns deterministic sampling mechanism only. DomainPack may publish greenSamplingPolicyRecommendation, and host application must intentionally pass pack or host options into buildRiskQueue; no hidden global green sampling default exists.

ddd_questions.question: Claim이 여러 Source Anchor를 필요로 하는 복합 주장일 때 하나의 anchor만으로 verified/corrected를 허용할 수 있는가?
ddd_questions.recommendation: v0 Claim은 single primary Source Anchor를 유지하되, composite claim은 Claim을 atomic subclaims로 분해한다. multi-anchor aggregate는 별도 scenario에서 다룬다.
ddd_questions.recommendation_reason: 현재 SourceAnchor/Claim model과 demo를 보존하면서 복합 주장의 허위 단일 앵커 문제를 피할 수 있다.
ddd_questions.options: A: single primary anchor only; B: multi-anchor Claim now; C: decompose composite claim into atomic claims
ddd_questions.answer: D-010: v0는 single primary Source Anchor와 atomic subclaim decomposition을 사용하고 multi-anchor aggregate는 별도 scenario로 미룬다.
